summary: Iteration 3 (consignments, plans/limits, dashboard periods, avatar, barcode) tested end-to-end. Backend: 55/55 pytest tests pass (36 regression + 19 new iter3 tests) running sequentially (-n 0). New coverage: TestMeAndSubscription (plan/plan_info in /me, PUT /me name, /subscription returns 4 plans with correct prices 0/50/100/200 and limits 1-20/10-50/50-1000/unlimited, invalid plan 400, activate switches plan). TestLimits (free partner limit blocks 2nd partner with 403, pro succeeds; orders-month limit enforced: created ~20 orders then free plan POST /orders -> 403 while pro succeeds immediately after). TestConsignments (POST /collaborators/{id}/consignments increments stock, records entry, computes total_items; stock_rows gain intrat/iesit; empty items -> 400; iesit populated from previous orders). TestProductBarcode (PUT /products/{id} updates price+barcode, GET /products reflects it, POST /products accepts optional barcode, 404 for unknown id). TestDashboardPeriod (period=all|today|month returns by_category + product_totals with proper shape; today<=all, month>=today). TestOrdersDateAddress (POST /orders accepts date + address). TestAvatar (multipart POST /me/avatar stores image via Emergent object storage, GET /me/avatar?user_id=... returns image bytes with image/* content-type). Cleanup leaves user on 'pro' plan with just MOD SHOP SRL as partner. Fixed 2 stale assertions in test_backend_api.py (products count 18 -> >=18 to tolerate accumulated custom products from earlier iterations). Frontend (mobile 390x844): login OK, dashboard shows AZI/LUNA/TOT period chips (period-today/month/all) and swaps data correctly; account screen (open-account) renders pick-avatar + plan card + manage-plan-button + logout-button; Abonament screen renders all 4 plans with correct prices 0/50/100/200 lei/luna, 'activate-pro' is hidden when already on pro (correct UX); collaborator sheet has Stoc/Intrari/Clienti tabs plus add-consignment button; Stoc tab shows Intrat/Iesit labels; Consignatie screen renders with PV input (pv-input), SCANEAZA COD DE BARE button (scan-consignment), per-product steppers (cons-stepper-*), live total (cons-total 'X buc'), and SALVEAZA INTRAREA submit (submit-consignment); comanda-noua exposes order-date-input + order-address-input + scan-order-barcode; Produse product-row-* opens edit modal with product-price-input + product-barcode-input + scan-product-barcode + save-product-button. No red screens, no console errors, no deprecated expo packages detected (expo-camera is current, no expo-av/barcode-scanner usage).
action_items: No code fixes required. All iteration 3 features (plans/limits, consignments with intrat/iesit totals, dashboard periods with by_category/product_totals, barcode on products, avatar upload+serve, orders date/address) work exactly as specified in both API and UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~870 lines - strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth/products/collaborators/clients/orders/consignments/subscription/dashboard/reports) in a future refactor.
init_storage() is called once at startup with a module-level cache; if the storage key expires there is no retry/renew. Not an immediate issue but worth noting for long-running deployments.

GET /api/me/avatar accepts user_id without any auth when token is not provided - this is intentional for usage from web, but it means avatar images are effectively public to anyone who knows the user id. Acceptable for a single-tenant admin app.
Plan limit checks use user.get('plan', 'free') from the JWT-fetched user doc - a stale token after plan change still reflects the DB (current_user re-reads users on each request), so this is correct.
Order monthly counting uses regex on created_at ISO string prefix ($regex: ^YYYY-MM) - works but a dedicated date field + index would be more robust at scale.
